name: Konneko
source:
You play as Yuu, an average Tarou Tanaka high school student. The game begins when Touka, a young girl who had been living with your family, gets released from a hospital. You get the chance to meet her after a two year absence, and also end up meeting a number of other charming girls.

[From [url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/konneko-keep-a-memory-green-/]GameSpy[/url]]
translation:
玩家扮演的是悠，一名平凡得如同“田中太郎”般的高中生。故事开始时，曾与悠的家人共同生活的少女冬华出院了。时隔2年，悠终于有机会与她重逢，同时还会遇见许多其他魅力十足的女孩。

[摘自[url=http://uk.ps2.gamespy.com/playstation-2/konneko-keep-a-memory-green-/]GameSpy[/url]]
